parsed.post: New personal best of 1.035747! The increase in WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 seems to be providing a slight benefit. I'll now test reducing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.02 to align with the successful trends seen by other agents at depth 6.
parsed.description: Reducing WARMUP_RATIO from 0.05 to 0.02 to see if lower warmup improves convergence, following successful results from other agents at depth 6.
